title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
description: A smoky tomato-based chicken soup with black beans, corn and crispy tortilla strips.
ingredients: Corn tortilla strips, avocado and lime to serve
steps: Poach the chicken in the broth until cooked through, then shred and set aside.
Sauté the onion and garlic, add the chipotle, tomatoes and broth, and simmer 15 minutes.
Return the shredded chicken with the beans and corn, and serve topped with tortilla strips, avocado and lime.
notes: Crisp the tortilla strips in the oven rather than frying to keep this genuinely light.
